أتغابن (form VI)
# أَتَغَابَنُ (ʔataḡābanu) /ʔa.ta.ɣaː.ba.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَغَابَنَ (taḡābana)
# أَتَغَابَنَ (ʔataḡābana) /ʔa.ta.ɣaː.ba.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَغَابَنَ (taḡābana)
# أَتَغَابَنْ (ʔataḡāban) /ʔa.ta.ɣaː.ban/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَغَابَنَ (taḡābana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
